subject: Ready to ignite: closure playbook and paperwork window
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
To: Ellen Park <ellen.park@atlashealth.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai, markus_klein@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 23 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Ready to ignite: closure playbook and paperwork window

Hi Ellen / Atlas team,

Thanks again for the productive evaluation week — the Atlas team’s MAP feedback was really helpful. Per our conversation, I’m attaching an updated mutual action plan (v3) plus a short SOW extract and our SLA excerpt for the commercial terms you flagged. The ask here is to lock the final paperwork window so we can start on the agreed pilot start date of July 5.

High-level proposed closure playbook (dates are optimistic but realistic):
- May 24–26: Legal & procurement exchange (redlines and SOC2 evidence)
- May 27–28: Executive approval window (internal signatures: Atlas exec + Redwood VP Sales + Redwood Legal)
- June 2: Final countersign / e-sign complete
- July 5: Pilot kickoff (30-day evaluation)

Specific items we need from you to hit this cadence:
1) Confirmation of the procurement contact who will own the DocuSign flow (Procurement Team added to cc if you want)
2) Any final security questionnaire items beyond what we sent yesterday
3) Confirmation if the July 5 start is firm or if you need a later kickoff window

Attachments: MAP_AtlasHealth_v3.xlsx (mutual action plan), SOW_AtlasHealth_v1.pdf (scope excerpt), Redwood-SLA-excerpt.pdf

If you’d like, Rishi can jump on a 20-minute slot tomorrow to walk legal through the DocuSign steps so we keep latency low — he’s copied.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Account Lead | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: MAP_AtlasHealth_v3.xlsx (xlsx)]
[Attachment: SOW_AtlasHealth_v1.pdf (pdf)]
[Attachment: Redwood-SLA-excerpt.pdf (pdf)]

From: Ellen Park <ellen.park@atlashealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procure@atlashealth.com>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 08:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Ready to ignite: closure playbook and paperwork window

Vanessa — thanks for the clear plan and the docs. A few quick notes from procurement/legal here: 

- We received the MAP and SOW, looks good overall. We have one ask on the SLA: need clearer wording on data retention for evaluation logs (our security team requires 90-day retention by default).
- Procurement will own the DocuSign flow; I’ve cc’d procurement but their lead (Michael Cho) is OOO until Tues afternoon. Expect a short delay while they review vendor addendum language.
- Can you confirm what signatures are needed on your side? We typically want to see the named signatory and the contact for billing.

Also, we may need a slightly later kickoff — July 12 instead of July 5 — if procurement’s review runs into early June. Not a dealbreaker but we wanted to flag it.

Thanks — Ellen
Ellen Park
Director, Product Ops | AtlasHealth
[External: procurement queries: procure@atlashealth.com]

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
To: Ellen Park <ellen.park@atlashealth.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai, markus_klein@redwood.ai, Procurement Team <procure@atlashealth.com>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Ready to ignite: closure playbook and paperwork window

Ellen — appreciate the quick turn. Short answers and an updated plan so procurement has clarity: 

1) Signatories on the Redwood side: VP Sales (Rishi Malhotra) will be the commercial signer; Legal (Markus Klein) will countersign for Redwood. Billing contact: finance@redwood.ai (we’ll add the invoice contact on DocuSign metadata).

2) Retention: we can accept 90-day evaluation-log retention for the pilot. I’ve flagged that to our Security PM; we’ll include the retention clause in the SOW extract and mark it as an evaluation-only exception. Attached: SOW_AtlasHealth_v1.pdf (updated with retention note).

3) Dates: Given Michael’s OOO, revised optimistic timeline below — this assumes procurement completes redlines by June 7: 
- May 24–June 7: Legal & procurement exchange (procurement window extended)
- June 8–11: Exec approval & signatory queue (Atlas exec + Redwood VP Sales + Redwood Legal)
- June 14: Countersign / e-sign complete (DocuSign link issued)
- July 12: Pilot kickoff (preferred by Atlas)

Rishi — can you confirm availability for exec signature between June 8–11? If we hit that window we should be able to lock July 12.

Thanks,
Vanessa
[Attachment: SOW_AtlasHealth_v1.pdf (pdf)]

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>, Ellen Park <ellen.park@atlashealth.com>
Cc: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai, markus_klein@redwood.ai, Procurement Team <procure@atlashealth.com>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 14:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Ready to ignite: closure playbook and paperwork window

Vanessa / Ellen — I’m available June 8–11 for the exec approval window. I’ll block June 9 at 10:00 PT as the primary signer slot; if that works for Atlas, Vanessa — please route DocuSign to the billing and exec contacts on the 9th.

Grace, Markus — please stand by for a quick legal/CS alignment call on June 8 to run through the retention clause and pilot acceptance criteria. I’ll send the calendar invites once Michael confirms procurement timing.

Looking forward to getting this across the finish line — July 12 kickoff works for me.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
VP Sales | Redwood Inference
[Calendar: Proposed signer slot June 9 10:00 PT]
[Attachment: none]
